tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Fast (1-3 s) risk verdict for an ERC-20 token before buying it: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH with reasons. Who controls it (renounced, single key, Safe multisig, timelock), upgradeable proxy, admin powers in the bytecode (mint, blacklist, pause, adjustable tax, trading switch), source verification, DEX liquidity

tools.name: gas_now
tools.description: Live EIP-1559 gas for a chain: base fee, slow/standard/fast tips, maxFeePerGas values and the cost of common actions. Chains: 1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56.

tools.name: address_info
tools.description: What is this address? EOA, EIP-7702 delegated EOA, Safe multisig (threshold, owners), timelock, ERC-20 token, proxy or contract, with native balance. Use before sending funds to or trusting an address.

tools.description: For x402 sellers: can a real buyer actually pay this endpoint? Sends one payment signed by a fresh unfunded key through the endpoint's server and facilitator.
